title: The corkboard, 2021
logline: Gully's corkboard in September 2021, the whole inventory: the yearbook photo lowest, the walk map, the Florence gull, the 61 MI postcard, the backward digest, the sticker upside down, TAKE-OUT ONLY. A private page of a public object. Nothing new on it.

panels.composition: A crowded corkboard filling the page: a small yearbook photo pinned lowest, a hand-drawn map, a photo of a large gull, a postcard, a small comic digest pinned backward, a sticker upside down, a hand-lettered card.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a crowded corkboard filling the page with a small yearbook photo pinned lowest, a hand-drawn map, a photo of a large gull, a postcard, a small booklet pinned backward, an upside-down sticker and a hand-lettered card, no words legible
image.notes: Inventory per objects.md; letter TAKE-OUT ONLY after if at all.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
